sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes Enablemypractice as AI-powered EHR + PMS + billing platform for 20+ specialties. Lists three core product pillars: AI-Powered EHR, AI PMS & Billing, Patient Engagement. McLean, VA based.

ONC mandatory disclosure page. Lists certification number, 44 tested criteria, 15 CQMs. Pricing details: Direct messaging $50/mo per account via Kno2/Surescripts. Data export, API access, patient health capture, implantable device tracking included at no charge.

Clinical documentation feature page. Details speech-to-text (Deepgram), AI note generation (ChatGPT), custom templates, auto-population of ICD-10/CPT/meds/allergies/vitals/immunizations, pull-from-prior, encrypted PDF storage, e-signatures.

Billing feature page. AI-powered coding from notes, code verification by payer/specialty, electronic claims submission, ERA processing, payment reconciliation, patient statements with card processing, AI OCR of paper EOBs, AR aging dashboard.

Patient engagement/telehealth page. Patient portal with access to summaries/notes/vitals/results, secure messaging with speech recognition, telehealth via web and mobile apps, automated notifications, patient surveys, bill pay, insurance updates.
Chronic care/population management page. Custom patient list generation, program/status tracking, vitals/nutrition tracking, population-level reporting, care coordination and outreach tools.

Scheduling feature page. Drag-and-drop graphical schedule, booking by provider/resource/facility/room, online patient self-booking, telehealth link auto-generation, Google Calendar sync, multi-channel notifications, eligibility checking, group appointments, waiting lists.

E-prescribing page. E-prescribing including EPCS, drug database with AI, medication reconciliation, PDMP/NARX score integration, medication/immunization inventory, medication administration records, formulary/benefits checking.
Labs page. Electronic orders/results with LabCorp, Quest, regional labs. In-house lab test management. Results review and patient portal transmission.

Intake/data capture page. Customizable intake forms via text/email/portal, AI insurance/ID card scanning, demographics/consent/guarantor/insurance collection, credit card on file (PCI), driver's license scanning, all data flows into chart.
RIS feature page. Radiology ordering via HL7 to PACS, PACS study prefetching, AI radiology reporting, custom radiology templates, MQSA tracking, MIPS reporting, DICOM management.

Predictive Decision Support page. AI-driven clinical decision support, risk management aligned to ONC HTI-1 and NIST AI RMF, continuous monitoring, incident tracking, reinforcement learning from provider feedback.

FindEMR product profile. Lists features including scheduling, clinical documentation, e-prescribing, patient portal, billing/claims, telehealth, document management, lab integration. Notes AES 256-bit encryption. 0 actual user reviews posted. Mixed sentiment scores listed but appear synthetic/estimated.

Software Advice profile (accessed via search snippets, page itself returned 403). Cloud-based EHR+PM, modular pricing, speech-to-text, customizable templates. Users praise customization and developer responsiveness.
Capterra profile (accessed via search snippets, page itself returned 403). Listed as Enablemyhealth/Enablemypractice. Cloud-based EHR+PM, modular, suited for multiple specialties.
SelectHub profile (accessed via search snippet). 100% satisfaction rating based on 3 reviews from 1 review site. Users note easy-to-use but configurable system, developers open to customization.
